what_it_is.prose: AIESL is India's largest MRO provider, carved out of Air India in 2013. AIESL provides base maintenance, line maintenance, and component MRO for Indian carriers' Airbus A320, Boeing 737, and Boeing 787 fleets. For military aerospace, AIESL has supported the IAF's IL-76 and Avro HS-748 fleet base maintenance and has bid for IAF contracts for the C-17 and C-130J MRO work. AIESL is also India's only DGCA-approved engine MRO for the CFM56 and GE90.

faq.question: What does AIESL do?
faq.answer: AIESL is India's largest MRO provider. It provides base maintenance, line maintenance, and component MRO for Indian carriers' Airbus A320, Boeing 737, and Boeing 787 fleets, and supports IAF IL-76 and Avro HS-748 maintenance.

faq.question: Is AIESL listed?
faq.answer: No. AIESL is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Air India Ltd, which itself was reacquired by the Government of India (Tata Group from January 2022).
